{"code": "import numpy as np

# Define treatment and control groups based on 'arm'
treatment_group = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']
control_group = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']

# Compute response rates
response_rate_treatment = treatment_group['responded'].mean()
response_rate_control = control_group['responded'].mean()

# Compute treatment effect as difference in proportions
treatment_effect = response_rate_treatment - response_rate_control

# Print results
print(f'Response rate (treatment): {response_rate_treatment:.4f}')
print(f'Response rate (control): {response_rate_control:.4f}')
print(f'Treatment effect (difference in proportions): {treatment_effect:.4f}')"}
